summary.intent: Execute Phase 21 (BYO IPFS Node Support) using GSD wave-based parallel execution, implementing SDK pinning abstractions, API endpoints, Settings UI, TEE migration backend, and verifying the full end-to-end BYO-IPFS flow.
summary.outcome: All 7 plans across 4 waves were executed and verified end-to-end, including a live Playwright demonstration of the pin migration UI triggering with 38 pins migrating from CipherBox to an external Kubo node via TEE.

repo: TEE worker does not auto-load .env files — env vars must be passed inline (e.g. TEE_SECRET=x npm run dev) since tsx watch doesn't use dotenv
tee-worker is not in the pnpm workspace — must be installed/started independently with npm
Auth store is memory-only (no localStorage/sessionStorage persistence), so browser auth state cannot be injected programmatically
test-login API endpoint creates auth records; calling it then using email OTP for the same identity causes duplicate key constraint on UQ_auth_methods_type_hash

Migration trigger in StorageTab required savedConfig to be non-null, meaning first-time users switching from default cipherbox mode never triggered migration — fixed by treating null savedConfig as implicit cipherbox mode
Filebase deprecated their standard PSA endpoint (/psa); Pinata's PSA endpoint also returns 404 — SaaS IPFS providers have diverged from standard specs
QEMU VM networking: host machine DHCP reassignment changed IP from 192.168.133.114 to 192.168.133.12 after Docker stack restart
OTP for any user running in the background dev process is readable from the task output file at /private/tmp/claude-501/.../tasks/*.output

code.finding: Kubo and PSA probes originally treated any non-200 response as 'endpoint not found', causing 401/403/422 auth failures to surface as misleading 'could not detect protocol' errors — fixed to distinguish auth failures from missing endpoints

Migration trigger condition required savedConfig non-null AND usedBytes > 0 AND teeKeys present — first-time users switching from default cipherbox had null savedConfig so migration never fired; fixed by treating null as implicit cipherbox mode
Migration is gated on teeKeys?.currentPublicKey — if TEE worker is not configured, the entire migration block is silently skipped with no user-visible error

workflow: GSD task output files for background bash commands are readable at /private/tmp/claude-501/.../tasks/<id>.output — always read these instead of asking the user
When diagnosing API failures, always check background pnpm dev output first via the task output file rather than making assumptions
For Playwright E2E with memory-only auth, email OTP flow is the reliable path — use a fresh email not previously touched by test-login to avoid duplicate key constraints
Kubo nodes need explicit CORS configuration before browser-side connection testing works: Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Access-Control-Allow-Methods, Access-Control-Allow-Headers

friction: DHCP reassigned host IP (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12) after Docker stack restart, requiring manual .env update across 5 references
TEE worker .env not loaded automatically — required discovering this at runtime when secret wasn't available
tee-worker not in pnpm workspace — couldn't use workspace tooling, had to install with npm separately
Filebase and Pinata SaaS PSA endpoints are non-functional (deprecated/non-standard), making real provider testing difficult
Playwright page crash when uploading multiple large files simultaneously — had to upload sequentially
OTP lookup confusion — assistant initially overcomplicated retrieval instead of reading the background task output file directly
test-login API call created a duplicate auth record that caused 500 on subsequent email OTP login for the same identity
Migration UI not visible on first test because TEE keys were null (TEE worker not configured), with no user-visible error explaining why
open_items: 21-07 benchmark baselines deferred — load test scenarios are written but never executed against a real provider; .planning/baselines/21-byo-baselines.md was never created
SaaS pinning providers (Pinata, Filebase) need server-side proxy for connection testing — browser-direct requests fail due to CORS or deprecated endpoints
Pinata-specific provider implementation needed — their v3 Files API diverges from PSA spec
Migration UI shows no error/explanation when teeKeys is null — silent skip is confusing UX
Two continuation agents for 21-06 and 21-07 were spawned but results not yet confirmed in transcript — phase verification step not yet complete
